item.aggregated_output: You are a stochastic unit-commitment heuristic advisor. You propose binary on/off schedules only; you are not the optimizer. item.text: The supplied gradients point to early shutdowns of the 197 MW units and removal of costly small units. I’m comparing four block schedules against the supplied reserve margins and minimum run times; cost and feasibility will still need independent validation.
